template: On the Grafana dashboard '{{v3}}' (already saved, with panels '{{v1}} Notes' and '{{v1}} Availability'), do two things and persist them: (1) In the top-bar time picker, change the time range to '{{v4}}'. (2) Open Dashboard settings (gear icon) > General, and add the tag 'bench' to the Tags field (type 'bench' and press Enter so it becomes a tag chip), then click 'Save dashboard'. In the save dialog that appears, make sure the checkbox 'Update default time range' IS ticked (this is essential so the 6-hour range is persisted into the saved dashboard), then confirm the save. Verify the save succeeded. Report: the tags shown in Dashboard settings > General afterwards, the time range shown in the top-bar time picker, and whether the 'Update default time range' checkbox was ticked when you saved.

provenance.instruction: On the Grafana dashboard 'fwgr31-n2 Bench Dashboard' (already saved, with panels 'fwgr31-n2 Notes' and 'fwgr31-n2 Availability'), do two things and persist them: (1) In the top-bar time picker, change the time range to 'Last 6 hours'. (2) Open Dashboard settings (gear icon) > General, and add the tag 'bench' to the Tags field (type 'bench' and press Enter so it becomes a tag chip), then click 'Save dashboard'. In the save dialog that appears, make sure the checkbox 'Update default time range' IS ticked (this is essential so the 6-hour range is persisted into the saved dashboard), then confirm the save. Verify the save succeeded. Report: the tags shown in Dashboard settings > General afterwards, the time range shown in the top-bar time picker, and whether the 'Update default time range' checkbox was ticked when you saved.
